exact_009_assembly_recheck: Native .009 assembly crop (900,1450)-(1950,2250) visibly labels the four positions D36, R57, D37, D33 from left to right. R57 is a vertical resistor directly in the narrow D36/D37 gap. All three package outlines have bottom-facing notches. This independently confirms the lower-row identity and orientation used for the owner component-side pin count; it does not identify the matching solder holes or the CAS-input driver.

D37.role: lower-row NAND between R57 and D33

R46.role: photo-visible vertical RC resistor between D33 and D103

fit.method: D36/D33 linear interpolation in the same raw frame, with R46 checked between D33/D103 and D103 retained as a held-out row-order checkpoint

upper_row_reclassification.basis: the .006 drawing places D39 immediately right of D92; the registered component frame literally shows decapped D92 immediately left of this top-notched KR1533LA3, while the separate lower-row target photo literally shows the bottom-notched D37 between R57 and D33

d36_solder_search_exclusion: Native crop (1980,460)-(2420,1020) of July solder image PXL_20260710_200522685.jpg has apparent mirrored columns near x2035/x2360, but each continues through more than D36's seven contacts per side in that crop. They cannot be accepted as D36's 14-pin solder footprint merely from the broad cross-face projection. The earlier D36.2 solder seed in endpoints.csv is in the separate 200530933.MP.jpg tile and is already marked registration-only; no D36.12/.13 solder joints or remote source are established by this candidate field.

d36_second_solder_search_exclusion.search_basis: Extrapolating the independently fitted D56 cross-face corners in d56-fit-correction.json puts the D36 component centre near solder (2187,284), well outside the D56 local fit rectangle; this is a search hint only.
d36_second_solder_search_exclusion.observation: The candidate field at approximately x2075/x2260 has at least eight repeated contact levels in each aligned column across the native crop, whereas D36 is a seven-contact-per-side DIP14. The upper and lower aligned joints also run beyond the component-side D36 package's projected height. No unique D36 pin-1 corner or held-out contact can be verified there.
d36_second_solder_search_exclusion.disposition: Reject this projected field as a D36 package fit. Do not transfer its copper to D36.12/.13; find the true solder field with local same-hole anchors before tracing the CAS input.

d36_solder_candidate_from_d40.search_basis: The independently fitted D40 component/solder pair in local-package-registration.json lies below D36 in the same component tile. Extrapolating from D40 shifts the D36 search west of the rejected D56-only projection.
d36_solder_candidate_from_d40.observation: Two aligned columns each contain seven soldered contacts at the DIP14 pitch. The field lies directly above the independently fitted D40 solder package and near the predicted D36 row. This is a geometrically plausible D36 candidate, unlike the longer field near x2075/x2260.
d36_solder_candidate_from_d40.cross_check: The independent D103 and D56 cross-face package centres pull a broad three-package interpolation east of this field, toward the rejected longer x2075/x2260 rows. The divergent projections show that a global transform across these photographed tiles is unsafe. A separate native crop (1260,20)-(1630,630) of the adjacent x1350/x1530 solder field shows eight contact levels per column, so it cannot be used as the expected DIP14 D37 neighbor to certify this candidate. Neither the D36.7 ground nor D36.14 +5 V corner can be uniquely recognized from this crop, and the visible candidate D36.11-level copper does not establish a same-hole match to R57.
d36_solder_candidate_from_d40.limit: The x/y extrapolation from D40 has no direct same-hole anchor at D36. The two seven-contact columns are candidate package geometry only: pin numbers, D36 identity, and any CAS-input copper are not yet promoted. Check neighboring R57/D37 contacts and a second independent cross-face anchor before assigning D36.12/.13.

d36_cross_face_fit_check.anchors: D40 component-alt/solder-alt contacts and, independently, D103 contacts from local-package-registration.json; both pairs refer to these exact two images.
d36_cross_face_fit_check.d40_local_affine: D40 contact fit RMS 0.16 px. Approximate D36 component corners (1830,965), (2000,965), (1830,1310), (2000,1310) project to solder (1925,190), (1745,189), (1923,557), (1743,556). The seven-contact candidate occupies columns near x1715/x1895 and rows y115-475: roughly 30 px horizontally and 75 px vertically away. This is extrapolation above D40, not a D36 same-hole fit.
d36_cross_face_fit_check.r57_negative_check: The same D40-local transform projects R57's component lead centres (2085,965)/(2085,1195) to solder near (1655,190)/(1654,435). In the native solder crop around x1550-1750 these points lie on bare substrate, not a recognizable pair of joints. Thus the D40 extrapolation cannot validate the R57 neighbor or assign D36 pin numbers to the candidate field.
d36_cross_face_fit_check.independent_d103_check: A D103-only affine projects the same D36 corners to solder x2142-2307 and y77-424, far east of the seven-contact candidate; D40 held-out RMS is about 294 px. A combined D40+D103 affine has about 24 px anchor RMS and up to about 49 px individual residual, so it cannot be treated as a reliable local registration.
d36_cross_face_fit_check.disposition: Keep the x1715/x1895 seven-contact field as an unassigned candidate. A verified D36 or R57 same-hole contact in this photo pair is required before tracing D36.12/.13 solder copper.

d36_component_pin_search.orientation: The molded notch is at the bottom; counting the complete seven-contact rows makes physical pin 1 bottom-right, pin 7 top-right, pin 8 top-left, and pin 14 bottom-left in this component view.
d36_component_pin_search.observation: The second and third contacts up from the lower-left pin-14 joint are the source-tied CAS NAND inputs D36.13 and D36.12 respectively. Native crop (1800,1160)-(1850,1290) shows a narrow bright F.Cu neck from the pin12 pad near y1205 down through y1220-1240 to the pin13 pad near y1258, with brown clearance west of it. The two pins are locally photo-joined on F.Cu; these are still not accepted solder-side same-hole matches or a remote driver assignment.

d36_may_cross_date: Independent May 19 component photo PXL_20260519_201927098.jpg native crop (1500,1400)-(2150,2350) directly shows the same КР531ЛА12 marking and bottom-facing notch beside the upright 20-ohm R57-position body. Counting seven left-row contacts from the bottom pin14 puts D36.13 immediately above and D36.12 next above. Native crop (1870,2020)-(1930,2140) repeats the short bright neck between those two adjacent pads, corroborating the July F.Cu tie. The crop does not identify a same-hole solder match or the common upstream source. The July coordinates remain the sharper probe centers.

d36_input_front_bridge_review.decision: Two independent native component views support a direct local F.Cu tie of D36.12 and D36.13, consistent with exact .009 sheet 2. This closes the owner-board local tie only. The backside D36 field and the tied input's upstream driver remain unregistered.

disposition: D37/D39 physical identities and placements corrected; R57 and R46 vertical placements, lead spans, and schematic values closed; electrical nets unchanged
